historicalDate.original: 16/28 октября 1829 г. — размен ратификаций Адрианопольского мира

baseStates.notes: Bounded post-Adrianople legal-border state. The already verified 1834–1835 main-Empire reconstruction contains the Turkmenchay and Adrianople settlement geometry and passes the non-Finland historical controls; Finland is supplied by its separately verified continuous component. No later external sovereign-area change is crossed before the source-declared 1834–1835 interval begins. This state starts only in the exact October 1829 ratification-exchange month and is not back-projected into the February 1828–September 1829 Turkmenchay-only interval.
